name: spacefast
description: Spacefast publishes files and folders to permanent web URLs with immutable versions, scoped access, and resumable MCP workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Publish files and folders to the web instantly.
interface.longDescription: Spacefast is the best place to share AI artifacts. Publish any file or folder and get a permanent URL, an immutable version URL, and — for anonymous publishes — a one-time claim flow. Supports custom domains, scoped access, version history, rollback, logs, signed uploads, and browser OAuth for team publishing.
defaultPrompt: Publish this project with Spacefast and return its live and immutable URLs.
